answer: Farming becomes a vertex bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every relic settlement recomputes the ferrous schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
